evidence.r1: Only the Before/After toggle, the vertical tool pill and the bottom rating bar over the photo are glass; the left/right info panels and filmstrip are opaque content, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r2: The toggle, tool pill and rating bar occupy separate non-overlapping regions of the photo, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r3: Three floating glass elements, each load-bearing (compare, adjust, rate/reject), shot-fv-light.
evidence.r4: All three floating elements show the same frosted regular-glass look over the photo in both schemes.
evidence.r5: No clear-variant glass is used; the crop popover (shot-menu-light) matches the same frosted treatment.
evidence.r6: Only the active tool icon in the vertical pill shows a warm highlight in shot-menu-light/dark; no other control is tinted.
evidence.r7: All floating elements show blur and highlight edges over the anvil photo rather than a flat fill, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r8: The toggle and rating-bar icons are capsules; the crop popover is a fixed-radius rounded rectangle, shot-menu-light.
evidence.r9: The 3:2/1:1/4:5/16:9 buttons inside the crop popover sit inset from the popover's own corner radius without pinching, shot-menu-light.
evidence.r10: The Before/After toggle and rating bar are capsules; the crop popover's aspect-ratio buttons are small, dense rounded rectangles, shot-menu-light.
evidence.r11: Before/After, the tool pill, and the rating bar are three separate glass groups over the photo, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r12: Before/After combines two text buttons in one pill; the tool pill and rating bar hold icon buttons only, so no pill mixes a text button with an icon button, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r13: Glass is applied to each pill's outer shape; icons sit on one shared surface rather than being individually glassed, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r14: The toggle, tool pill and rating bar keep clear gaps between them across the photo, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r15: shot-full-light/dark are pixel-identical to shot-fv-light/dark; the filmstrip and side panels never show content scrolling beneath a floating bar in these captures.
evidence.r16: All three floating elements sit over the high-contrast anvil photo, never a flat field, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r17: Only the photo, not the info panels or filmstrip, sits beneath the floating toggle, tool pill and rating bar at rest, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r18: Toggle and rating-bar icons read clearly white-on-dark-glass against the photo in both schemes.
evidence.r19: shot-reduced only shows the transparency switch turning floating elements solid; no increased-contrast or reduced-motion state is captured.
evidence.r20: Fixed side panels (histogram/adjustments on the right, keys/cull counts on the left) plus top/bottom margins occupy the frame in shot-fv-light/dark, so the photo itself never reaches the window's edges; the panels sit beside the content instead of the content reaching full bleed.
evidence.r21: The photo meets the side panels at a sharp rectangular seam with no gradient or background extension in shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r22: The crop popover (shot-menu-light/dark) adds no dark scrim behind it beyond its own glass edge.
evidence.r23: Only the crop popover's position beside the tool pill (shot-menu-light) can be checked from stills, not morph or press feedback.
evidence.r24: Toggle and rating-bar icons are monochrome white/grey by default; the one warm highlight marks only the active tool, matching the single-tint allowance, shot-menu-light.
evidence.r25: White toggle/rating text and icons stay distinct from the photo's dark tones in both schemes.
